title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
阴暗的密室里，四面高墙。高墙上开了个四方小口。一点微薄的新鲜空气徐徐散了进来。一个年轻男子狼狈的靠坐在角落里，脸色惨白，微咳，有些虚弱。密室越发潮湿。外面应该是下雨了。那处小口飘进了些雨滴。他的脸上落上了几滴水珠，微微仰头，他被关在这里一个星期了。后颈的腺体在发烫，他真的好想他。“啪嗒！”密室的门终于开了，乌黑一片的空间涌入大片的光亮。男子吃力得坐了起来，眼眸发亮，希冀得望向门口。一个头发花白，威严的老者，手拄着拐杖，缓缓得走进来。不，不是他。男子失落得靠回了墙上。老者轻哼，嗓音浑厚却沧桑。“怎么，以为是阿宴是吗？”男子没有说话，只是低垂着头。老者低垂着眼眸，“下个月初八，阿宴会和苏家omega联姻。”男子晶亮的眼里的那点星光熄灭了。老者像是看出了他的心思。“你该知道，你只是阿宴的手下”“你一个alpha，也敢不知羞耻勾引他，要不是看在阿宴的份儿上，我也不会留你这条贱命，从今以后，我不许你再出现在阿宴面前。”男子眼神空洞。老者看了他几眼，便转身走到门口停住。他轻侧着脸，“明日凌晨0点，我会让老赵带你离开滨都市，我警告你，如果让我再发现你与阿宴纠缠不休，绝不轻饶！”男子微微张嘴，用了很多力气，终于艰难的蹦出他这辈子最难以启齿的一个字，“是”最后还打着颤音。他红着眼看着密室的门紧紧关上，不停的用后脑勺磕着墙面，最后缓缓的倒下，水雾溢满了眼眶，泪水顺着脸颊落在了地上。喉咙里吐出闷闷的呜咽声。可我是真的喜欢你，喜欢你。他不知道自己现在是身体更痛还是心更痛。

这世界上未知的东西，远比他们知道的多很多。就比如他已经有了...……天边的白云染上了夕阳的红，很暖，很舒服。乐安市，正南方的盘山别墅区。蜿蜒盘旋的公路上，一辆白中带粉的mini小车慢悠悠的开着。这速度慢得堪比乌龟爬坡。周边的车辆一辆辆陆陆续续的从它两侧经过。小车依旧不急不快保持20码的速度。车里放着欢快的音乐。车窗半开，时不时传来了清脆的歌声，音质是清朗好听，可惜没有一处在调上。一个多小时过去了。粉色小车终于开进了一处气派得别墅，车就停在别墅的院子里。一个年轻男生从车上蹦了下来，手里拎着一个行李箱。他上身粉色t恤，下身白色休闲裤。清爽俏皮的打扮，可以看出来他开朗活泼的性格。他长得并不惊艳。圆脸，很耐看。他有着白净的肌肤，明亮的眼眸，鼻梁不高挺却俏，唇色粉嫩，后颈处贴着白色的阻隔贴。这是个身量不高的omega，身材并不消瘦，肉眼可见得圆润。男生轻轻得咧着嘴角，眸中星光点点，脸颊两处的酒窝，让并不惊艳的圆乎乎的脸蛋洋溢出一张灿烂动人的笑容。他拖着行李朝着大门走去，欢快得朝着屋内大喊，“老王，你家善解人意、人见人爱、花见花开的小王回来啦，还不速速前来接驾。”激动，兴奋，无比得想要呐喊！他，王多多，今天大学毕业了。他终于结束了这二十多年的苦逼读书生涯，这对一个学渣来说是多多幸福美妙的事情，未来他再也不用动脑，他可以肆无忌惮的享受废材的人生。“回来就回来，在门口嚷嚷什么！赶紧给我滚进来！”中气十足得怒吼声像极了电视上的河东狮吼，瞬间从屋内传了出来。这嗓门怕是方圆十里都要听见了。“嗷~”很好，美丽的心情烟消云散了。一点也没有情调。“玉e~”王多多嫌弃得对着大门吐着舌头。他正要拎起箱子上台阶。两个男仆匆匆跑了过来，对他恭敬得喊着少爷；
content_en:
In a dark secret room, there are four high walls.A small square opening opened in the high wall.A little bit of fresh air slowly came in.A young man was sitting awkwardly in the corner, his face was pale, he was coughing slightly, and he was a little weak.The secret room became increasingly humid.It must be raining outside.Some raindrops drifted into that small opening.A few drops of water fell on his face and he raised his head slightly. He had been locked up here for a week.The glands in the back of his neck were burning, he really missed him."Bah!" The door of the secret room finally opened, and a large amount of light poured into the dark space.The man sat up with difficulty, his eyes bright, looking towards the door with hope.A dignified old man with gray hair, holding a cane, walked in slowly.No, not him.The man leaned back against the wall in despair.The old man hummed softly, his voice rich but aged."Why, do you think it's Ayan?" The man said nothing, just lowered his head.The old man lowered his eyes and said, "On the eighth day of next month, A-Yanyan will marry the Su family omega." The starlight in the man's bright eyes went out.The old man seemed to have read his thoughts."You should know that you are just Ayan's subordinate." "You are an alpha, but you dare to seduce him shamelessly. If it were not for Ayan's sake, I would not have spared your life. From now on, I will not allow you to appear in front of Ayan again." The man's eyes were empty.The old man looked at him for a few times, then turned and walked to the door to stop.He tilted his face slightly, "At 0:00 tomorrow morning, I will let Lao Zhao take you out of Bindu City. I warn you, if I find you entangled with Ayan again, I will never let you go!" The man opened his mouth slightly, used a lot of effort, and finally said the most difficult word in his life, "Yes" with a trembling sound at the end.He watched the door of the secret room close tightly with red eyes, and kept banging the back of his head against the wall. Finally, he slowly fell down, mist filling his eyes, and tears falling down his cheeks to the ground.A muffled whimper came out of his throat.But I really like you, like you.He didn't know whether he was in more pain physically or mentally.

There are far more unknown things in this world than they know.It's like he already has... The white clouds on the horizon are dyed red with the sunset, very warm and comfortable.Le'an City, Panshan Villa Area in the south.On the winding road, a white and pink mini car drove slowly.This speed is as slow as a turtle climbing uphill.The surrounding vehicles passed one after another on both sides of it.The car still maintained a speed of 20 yards without any hurry or speed.There is cheerful music playing in the car.The car window was half-open, and crisp singing could be heard from time to time. The sound quality was clear and pleasant, but unfortunately nothing was in tune.More than an hour passed.The pink car finally drove into a magnificent villa and parked in the yard of the villa.A young boy jumped out of the car, carrying a suitcase in his hand.He is wearing a pink T-shirt and white casual pants.His cheerful and lively personality can be seen in his refreshing and playful appearance.He doesn't look amazing.Round face, very attractive.He has fair skin, bright eyes, a straight but pretty nose, pink lips, and a white barrier patch on the back of his neck.This is an omega who is not tall in stature. His figure is not thin, and he is visibly rounded to the naked eye.The boy grinned slightly, his eyes were starry, and the dimples on his cheeks made his round face, which was not stunning, reveal a bright and moving smile.He dragged his luggage towards the door and shouted happily into the house, "Old Wang, your considerate, beloved and blooming little Wang is back. Come and pick him up quickly." He was so excited that he wanted to shout!He, Wang Duoduo, graduated from college today.He finally ended his more than 20 years of hard studying, which was a lot of happiness and wonderful things for a scumbag. In the future, he would no longer have to use his brain, and he could enjoy the life of a useless person unscrupulously."Come back as soon as you come back. What are you yelling at the door! Get out of here!" The roar was so angry that it was like the roar of the Hedong lion on TV, and it was instantly heard from inside the house.I'm afraid this voice can be heard within a ten-mile radius."Ouch~" Very good, the beautiful mood disappeared.There is no sentiment at all."Jade~" Wang Duoduo stuck out his tongue at the door in disgust.He was about to pick up the box and go up the steps.Two male servants hurried over and called him Master with great respect;
